d: When buying a luxury car, we usually look at its design, comfort and brand value. But in the era of electric vehicles, technology has become equally important. Because today, a premium electric car is not just about how it drives, but also about how intelligently it integrates into your everyday life. And today, we're reviewing the BMW iX1 Long Wheelbase, India's first locally assembled BMW electric car, priced at ₹54.70 lakh (ex-showroom). It offers a claimed MIDC range of 531 kilometres, a curved digital display, connected-car features and DC fast-charging capabilities of up to 130kW.…
